notes.title: Pet Rock Duty Update V1.15.5!
notes.content:
Along with a couple minor visual changes here and there, in this update I have added an Art Gallery to the bonus content menu that is unlocked after beating the games hardest standard difficulty! 

This gallery includes a couple pieces of great art made by friends and fans of the game that I really loved and wanted to find a place for in the actual game! I hope you enjoy it! (If you get to see it that is.)

notes.title: Pet Rock Duty update V1.14.5
notes.content:
Adding some nifty new features and adjusting some minor things!

Added:
-A flashlight that can by found by the basement door to make navigating the darkness down there easier
-Volume controls on the settings menu
-Small sounds that play when messing with your fellow classmates (which you shouldn't do, they're trying to learn)

Adjustments:
-Made Bobby's jumpscare sound slightly quieter
-Fixed a minor graphical bug that appeared on the pause menu

I know it's not much, but I'm working to make the game the best it can be little bit by little bit! Any suggestions for the game are very much appreciated if you're interested in including any of them in a Steam review!

notes.title: Pet Rock Duty V1.11.5
notes.content:
Just some general updates, tweaks, and bug fixes for the game!

[list]
[*]Updated how to play menu 
[*]Changed music for "advancing" 
[*]Made it so having the hall pass inside the classroom will no longer count as it being used 
[*]Fixed a bug that could happen with The Hall Monitor grabbing you through certain walls 
[*]Added new poster making it clear you can throw things away using trash cans 
[*]Made certain mechanics and threat inclusions more clear 
[*]Added some small visual changes to Final Exam
[*]Made Bobby more handsome
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Small update making things more clear
notes.content:
Just thought I would tweak a couple small things to make certain mechanics and aspects of the game easier to understand for new players. 

Mainly adding tips that show up for when an Outsider is at a window the first time they arrive, and adding a section on the how to play menu dedicated to explaining the differences between each difficulty and they different traits they all have.

Hope this clears some things up for anybody playing for the first time!

notes.title: Pet Rock Duty Sticker Update! (And some general patches)
notes.content:
I am very happy to announce that stickers have now been added to Pet Rock Duty! 

Stickers are something you collect throughout your time playing through various means, and they can be used as decoration for Bobby the Rocks shell! Place any assortment of stickers you want on Bobby to make him look the best he can be while tearing your flesh off!

Along with this, there have also just been some general improvements and polish added to some areas of the game such as:

[list]
[*]Tweaking the appearance of some posters
[*]Fixing a lighting bug that could happen on the ceiling when The Hall Monitor appears
[*]Making some menus more visually appealing
[*]Adding new sound design for performing certain actions
[*]Re-writing the "How to escape" portion of the how to play menu to not be as wordy
[*]Probably some other stuff I'm forgetting
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the new updates!
